verdict.rationale: The pack documents REST endpoints (POST /acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/tokens, credential retrieval) in human-readable docs, an llms.txt documentation index, a TAP protocol spec, and an MCP server. None of these is shown to be a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec for the Intelligent Commerce APIs. Machine-readable specs are a fair axis for an API product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.
